problem_type: Mixed-integer convex quadratic program (MIQP) with cardinality, long-only, and full-investment constraints

decisions.business: Fraction of capital allocated to each security; the objective is to minimize the sum of half the portfolio variance and the concentration penalty, minus the weighted expected return.
decisions.completeness: Must contain exactly n finite nonnegative numbers, ordered by security index and summing to 1; together with selected, must satisfy the per-security thresholds and all linear rules.

decisions.business: Whether each security enters the final portfolio; 1 means it receives a positive investment fraction, 0 means it is not invested in.
decisions.completeness: Must contain exactly n 0/1 values in the same order as weights; selected[i]=1 if and only if weights[i]>0, and the number of 1s must not exceed max_securities.
